prompt: Global Property Editor: Generate a VIKTOR app that uploads an IFC file and provides: A UI to select an existing property (e.g. "Phase" or "Status") and input a new value. A function to batch update that property for all elements (or all of a certain type) in the model, then output the modified IFC (e.g. set "Phase" of all elements to "Construction"). (Pain point: Rapidly updating global metadata across a model without manual edits.)
